title: Glasses
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- glasses frame: bright teal, distinct from lenses -->
  <!-- left lens -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='50' r='17' fill='#2a3d5a' stroke='#4de0d0' stroke-width='5'/>
  <!-- right lens -->
  <circle cx='70' cy='50' r='17' fill='#2a3d5a' stroke='#4de0d0' stroke-width='5'/>
  <!-- bridge -->
  <rect x='44' y='46' width='12' height='7' rx='3' fill='#4de0d0'/>
  <!-- left temple arm going off to the left -->
  <rect x='6' y='45' width='12' height='7' rx='3' fill='#4de0d0'/>
  <!-- right temple arm going off to the right -->
  <rect x='82' y='45' width='12' height='7' rx='3' fill='#4de0d0'/>
  <!-- lens shine highlights, lighter shade so lenses read as glass -->
  <path d='M22 42 Q26 36 33 38' stroke='#7fb0d8' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M62 42 Q66 36 73 38' stroke='#7fb0d8' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- sparkle on frame -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='33' r='2.5' fill='#b6fff4'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='33' r='2.5' fill='#b6fff4'/>
</svg>
